title: Model-comparison probe: does a stronger model break the Upworthy rank-ceiling? (#342)
design: light blinded order-randomized clickability elicitation on the IDENTICAL 60 cases as the committed Groq confirming run; controlled light-elicitation arm (NOT the heavy 200-agent panel)
scoring: directional_gate G0-G11, delta=0.0, budget=15 (top 25%), bootstrap=2000 over experiments, 90% CIs, seed=42

hypotheses.H2: does EITHER arm show any rank tracking (rho 90% LB > 0)?
hypotheses.H3: does ANY arm clear the gate (balanced SMR>=0.70 & Kendall tau_b>=0.30)? predicted NO

decision_rule: If sonnet_panel rho 90% LB > 0 AND exceeds groq_panel -> signal worth a heavy pre-registered Sonnet pass. Else: rank-ceiling looks model-robust at light elicitation; feed into whitepaper.
